verdict.rationale: Linear has well-documented GitHub integration features (assigning reviews to GitHub teams, opening GitHub-synced issues, Copilot cloud agent assignment) implying sync exists, and a public GraphQL API plus webhooks that could support custom bi-directional sync, but there's no explicit documentation of native, out-of-the-box bi-directional status/field syncing with GitHub Issues (e.g., closing a GitHub issue auto-closes Linear issue) to fully confirm this story is delivered without engineering effort.
